correctness.rationale: Ko–Park Theorem 3.16 gives H1(Z)=Z^8⊕Z/2 for the three-connected nonplanar Heawood graph. Abrams two-particle cubical cell counts 91/252/168 and Euler characteristic 7 imply free H2(Z)=Z^14. The canonical equivariant chain map to Heawood graph chains maps lifted 28 six-cycles onto a spanning set of graph H1, so H1 rationally equals the eight-dimensional graph cycle module. Exact signed cellular Hopf trace formulas yield all characters; two standalone verifiers reconstruct 336 genuine automorphisms, full signed chain traces and six-cycle span, all 8 order/side-switch classes and zero invariants; finite-field checks are only cross-checks.
